transcript:
Patient Bot: Hello. I'm calling because I need to cancel an upcoming
PGAI Agent: Prima installs Thanks for calling PivotPoint Orthopedics.
Patient Bot: appointment.
PGAI Agent: Part of Pretty Good AI. Am I speaking with Sarah?
Patient Bot: Hi. Um, this is Maria Rodriguez. Hi. No. This is Maria Rodriguez. I actually need to cancel my appointment. Could you help me with that?
PGAI Agent: Please provide the full name and date of birth of the patient whose appointment you'd like to cancel.
Patient Bot: Sure. It's Maria Rodriguez. My date of birth is July 22nd 19 90.
PGAI Agent: Just to confirm, could you please spell your 1st and last name for me?
Patient Bot: Of course, it's m a r a, last name, r o d r I g e z.
PGAI Agent: Could you confirm if your 1st name is spelled m a r a or m a r I a?
Patient Bot: Oh, I'm sorry. It's m r I a, Maria.
PGAI Agent: Would you like to use your phone number to look up your record? If so, please provide the number you have on file with us. If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again. Which would you prefer?
Patient Bot: Uh, yes. I can provide my phone number. Um, I think you can just use my name and date of birth. That should be fine. Thanks.
PGAI Agent: No problem. Could you please spell your 1st and last name for me 1 more time just to be sure?
Patient Bot: Sure. It's m a r I a, and last name is r o I g e z.
PGAI Agent: I have your phone number as 2 1 9 2 8 5 7 6 0 9. And your date of birth is July 22nd 19 90. Is that correct?
Patient Bot: Yes. That's correct. Thank you.
PGAI Agent: I can't proceed further right now, but I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Please hold while I update your request for our staff. Connecting you to a representative. Please wait.
Patient Bot: Okay. Thank you so much. I
PGAI Agent: Hello. You've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye.
Patient Bot: Hi. Um, this is Maria Rodriguez. Alright. Thanks for your help. I guess I'll wait for the clinic to get back to me then. Have a good day. Goodbye.
summary: Maria Rodriguez called to cancel an appointment but encountered difficulties with the AI agent verifying her identity, despite providing her name, date of birth, and phone number multiple times. The AI agent was unable to process the cancellation directly and informed Maria that the clinic support team would follow up with her. The call ended with Maria acknowledging she would wait for the clinic to contact her.
